description: Browse the catalog of stream packages (bundles of streams sold as one subscription) with available prices, most-subscribed first. Requires a linked account, unlike streams_all and search. Use list_my_stream_packages for your created or subscribed packages. Does not create a subscription or charge the user.

limit.description: Maximum number of items in this page.

nextToken.description: nextToken from the previous page; keep the other inputs unchanged.

queryType.description: ALL for every package, FEATURED for featured packages only.

streamPackageCategory.description: Only packages in this topic category. Omit for any category.

name: list_stream_packages

id.description: Package ID for get_stream_package or get_stream_package_subscription.

amount.description: Price in the currency’s smallest unit.

title: Browse stream packages
